purpose: Controlled corrected-head source, integration and Playwright proof for Pete Phase 14.
preconditions: Tenfold generation-5 authority preflight is PROVEN.
STATIC_PETE_REVIEW, STATIC_HUNTER_REVIEW and STATIC_ADMIN_REVIEW are PROVEN through Tenfold Officers/Council on generation 5.
The exact three candidate heads above have not moved.
A current reachable OracleLiveContext is bound to the target node before dispatch.
Each repository is materialized in an isolated clean worktree at its exact candidate head.
No private project source is copied into the public Tenfold repository.
Source-run proof occurs before Wrangler/package/build proof.
Packet preparation is not execution proof and does not authorize Ship.

hunter.runtime: Python environment containing the existing Hunter Flask/requests and repository test dependencies plus Node.js >=22
commands: python -m py_compile hunter_pete_admin.py hunter_pete_admin_bridge.py hunter_pete_admin_bridge_runtime.py hunter_pete_runtime.py run_hunter_cognitive_bridge.py test_hunter_pete_admin_phase14.py tests/test_phase14_pete_admin_bridge.py tests/test_cognitive_bridge_service_install.py
requiredResults: dedicated Cognitive Bridge mounts only bounded Pete admin state/control and enforces bridge-secret denial
Workers VPC allows Pete admin state/control, strips browser Authorization, and rejects Pete invoke exposure
Cloud owner-plane Phase 14 source verifier PASS
missing HUNTER_PORTAL_KV returns HTTP 503 PETE_ROUTE_POLICY_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE and does not claim persistence or apply the local model-control path
existing Admin-control owner-auth boundary regression PASS
HTTPS/clean-origin negative cases PASS without secret dispatch
all Admin source tests PASS including Phase 14 one-mount/proxy/origin-negative cases

integrationProof.requiredComposition: Admin same-origin -> Hunter owner plane -> authenticated Workers VPC Cognitive Bridge -> dedicated local Hunter Cognitive Bridge -> bounded Pete admin handlers -> private Pete MCP

cases.action: As an approved owner_admin session, GET /api/hunter/pete through the Admin source server.
assert: HTTP 200
Hunter remains visible identity
Pete snapshot schema is pete.admin_snapshot.v1
provider/model state comes from Pete
ownerPolicy/controlOwner come from Hunter
no Pete token, cognitive bridge secret, private loopback URL, raw prompt/transcript or hidden reasoning is returned

cases.action: Select a real current Pete registry model and POST manual policy through /api/hunter/pete/model-control.
assert: unknown model is rejected before persistence
known model is persisted by Hunter
runtime application is truthful
paid model auto-adds to explicit approved paid allow-list where required
Pete registry itself is not mutated

cases.action: Reset owner policy through the Admin route.
assert: mode becomes auto_free_only
manualTarget becomes null
allowPaidFallback becomes false

cases.action: Re-read state after process/browser reload rather than relying on in-memory UI state.
assert: Hunter persisted policy is re-read
policy/runtime synchronization status is truthful

cases.action: Repeat state/control requests without an approved owner_admin session.
assert: owner surface/state is denied
control mutation is denied
normal non-Pete employee/public behavior remains unchanged

cases.action: Exercise the committed non-HTTPS/invalid-origin negative cases across Admin upstream and Hunter bridge transport.
assert: owner bearer is never sent to an invalid Admin upstream
cognitive bridge secret is never sent to an invalid Hunter/local origin

cases.action: Exercise the deployed bridge route allow-list through the Workers VPC transport.
assert: GET /api/local/cognitive/pete is forwarded only with the dedicated bridge secret
POST /api/local/cognitive/pete/model-control is forwarded only with the dedicated bridge secret
browser Authorization is not forwarded to the VPC target
/api/local/pete/invoke and chat routes are not exposed by the VPC bridge

cases.action: Make the Hunter owner route-policy store unavailable and submit a valid reset/control request.
assert: Hunter returns HTTP 503 PETE_ROUTE_POLICY_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE
the response does not claim ownerPolicyStatus persisted
the local Pete model-control route is not called after failed persistence
the request is not misclassified as invalid policy

playwrightProof.engine: Playwright through the governing Oracle/browser facility against source-run services
cases: Systems contains exactly one Pete region and existing non-Pete Systems controls still function.
Pete page renders loading, error, unavailable and available state truthfully with no duplicate mount.
Provider/model table identifies Free/Paid, health, quota, location, effective state and reason.
Owner can Save a valid manual policy by clicking the rendered control.
Invalid/unknown manual selection is visibly blocked and is not persisted.
Policy-persistence outage is visibly unavailable and is not presented as invalid policy or successful save.
Reset button returns to free-only and survives reload.
Reload re-reads persisted Hunter policy rather than only browser memory.
Unavailable cognitive state remains explicit after reload.
Employee/public access is denied and owner controls are not exposed.
Desktop and mobile screenshots are captured.
DOM and captured network payloads contain no Pete auth token, cognitive bridge secret, private MCP URL, raw prompt/transcript or hidden reasoning.

commands: Hunter worker: npm run check in an isolated exact-head worktree, then prove worktree remains semantically/exactly clean or record any generated-source effect
All three: exact changed-file/authority/security negative scan
postBehaviorRegression.note: Wrangler dry-run/package proof is intentionally deferred until source-run and Playwright lanes are green.

globalStopConditions: Oracle Live context identity/generation/epoch changes before or during dispatch.
Any private credential/token/secret appears in output, DOM, network artifacts or screenshots.
A new authority owner or duplicate policy/state store is required.
A source test, integration assertion, UI action or reload-persistence assertion fails.
The target worktree is dirty before proof or unexpectedly dirty after proof.
An actionable external review or Sergeant finding appears.
nonClaims: Packet preparation is not Oracle Live proof.
